title: Home security deals UK: SimpliSafe vs Ring, and prices to pay
description: Home security deals UK: Ring Alarm kits from £219, SimpliSafe monitoring from 66p a day, and which system to buy. Prices checked 3 November 2026.
intro:
**The best home security deal we can confirm today is Ring's Alarm Pack M (2nd Gen) at £239.99 direct from Ring, a five-sensor kit with keypad and range extender, or £259.99 with an indoor camera added.** If you want someone else to watch the alarm for you, SimpliSafe is the better system: its professional monitoring starts at 66p a day, with no contract and the first month free.

Neither brand is heavily discounted yet, and the cheapest Ring Alarm price on record is well below today's. Unless you need an alarm now, we'd wait for Black Friday on 27 November. Prices were checked on 3 November 2026.

body:
## SimpliSafe vs Ring: the short version

Both are DIY wireless alarms you fit yourself in an hour or so, with door and window sensors, motion detectors, a keypad and an app. The big difference is who responds when the alarm goes off.

- **SimpliSafe** offers professional monitoring. On its Pro Premium plan, a monitoring centre checks the alarm is real and can send a Securitas guard. You don't have to watch your phone.
- **Ring** is self-monitored. With a Ring plan, Alarm Calls phone up to three people you choose, and the base station keeps working on mobile data if your broadband drops. Ring doesn't offer professional monitoring in the UK.

So if you're often away, or you want the alarm watched when you can't answer your phone, buy SimpliSafe. If you mainly want a loud siren, app alerts and a camera, and you already have a Ring doorbell, Ring is cheaper to buy and to run.

## What SimpliSafe costs to run

SimpliSafe has no contract: you can pause, cancel or restart monitoring at any time. Its current UK plans are:

- **Pro Standard, 66p a day (about £20 a month):** professional monitoring and a two-year extended warranty.
- **Pro Premium, 93p a day (about £28 a month):** adds verified alarms with guard response, fire response, unlimited camera recording with 30 days of cloud storage, up to £350 towards your insurance excess (conditions apply) and 20% off future hardware.

The first month is free. Its Starter kit includes a base station, keypad, entry sensor, motion sensor and indoor camera. SimpliSafe says its systems start from under £200, and every package is on [SimpliSafe's packages page](https://simplisafe.co.uk/home-security-shop-packages). We couldn't confirm today's kit prices, so we've left SimpliSafe out of the deal cards above. There's no sitewide sale on yet, so if you're not in a hurry, it's worth waiting to see what it does for Black Friday.

## What Ring costs to run

You can use a Ring Alarm with no subscription for the siren, sensors and basic app alerts. A Ring plan unlocks remote arming and disarming, Alarm Calls and mobile-data backup. Ring now sells two levels: Solo (one device) and Multi (every Ring device at one address). New alarm kits come with a 30-day free trial, so you can see whether you need it before you pay.

## Which kit size to buy

- **Flat or small house:** a five-piece kit (base station, keypad, one or two door sensors, a motion detector) covers the front door and main room. Ring's basic kit is about £219.
- **Three-bed house:** go for Ring's M or L pack, or SimpliSafe's mid-sized packages. You'll want a sensor on every outside door and a motion detector downstairs.
- **Big house or outbuildings:** Ring's XL pack (£389.99, with an outdoor siren) or a SimpliSafe package with an external bell box. An outside bell box also shows would-be burglars the house is alarmed.

If you're hoping for a cheaper home insurance quote, ask your insurer first whether it recognises a DIY alarm, as policies differ.

## Prices to aim for on Black Friday

- **Ring Alarm five-piece kit:** about £180 is a good price, against £219 today.
- **Ring Alarm Pack M with Indoor Camera:** under £240 is a good price.
- **Yale Smart Home Alarm Family Kit:** anything under £300 is a strong price.

Ring is owned by Amazon, so Amazon's Black Friday sale is the one to watch for Ring kits. It hasn't started yet (see our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/)). Ring's doorbell prices are in our [Ring doorbell Black Friday deals guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), and every brand guide is on our [Black Friday 2026 hub](/black-friday/).

## FAQs

### Is SimpliSafe better than Ring?

For most people who want an alarm someone else watches, yes. SimpliSafe has professional monitoring with guard response, while Ring only alerts you and the people you choose. Ring is cheaper and works better if you already use Ring cameras or a doorbell.

### Do you have to pay a monthly fee for a Ring Alarm?

No. The siren, sensors and basic app alerts work without a plan. You need a Ring plan for remote arming, Alarm Calls and mobile-data backup.

### Is SimpliSafe tied to a contract?

No. SimpliSafe's monitoring is a rolling plan you can pause or cancel at any time, and the first month is free.

### When is the best time to buy a home alarm?

Black Friday (27 November 2026) and the days around it, when Amazon's sale runs. Today's Ring prices are fair but not the lowest on record, so wait unless you need one now.
